title: Evo 2: the largest AI model for biology
summary: Trained on more than 9.3 trillion nucleotides from over 128,000 genomes, it reads sequences up to 1 million nucleotides, flags harmful mutations, and designs genetic elements and genomes as long as those of simple bacteria. In BRCA1 tests it exceeds 90% accuracy in distinguishing benign from potentially pathogenic variants (a result limited to that gene). Preprint; human pathogens were excluded from training.

evidence.tested: The model was tested on BRCA1 variants, where it reached over 90% accuracy distinguishing benign from potentially pathogenic mutations, and on identifying genetic changes affecting protein function and fitness.
evidence.unknown: The source reports the BRCA1 result for one gene only and states no other limitations beyond human pathogens being excluded from training.
evidence.ai_role: A genome language model trained on 9.3 trillion nucleotides flags harmful mutations and designs genetic elements.
